label: calculated
excluded: Disk: 64 GB ephemeral NVMe per sandbox is included; no separate disk charge (SDK 3.0.0+ or custom image; 32 GB for deprecated runtimes).

Network: data the sandbox sends to the internet and all traffic on exposed ports is billable, downloads are free. Priced at the iad1 list rate, $0.15/GB. Plan allowances are not deducted: Hobby includes 20 GB/month, and the plan table lists Pro data transfer as included in Flat Rate CDN, whose lowest tier, included with Pro, has a capacity of 1 TB of data transfer each month. A sandbox that sends almost no data pays almost nothing here.
Drives (not included in the hourly rates here): $0.05/GB-month storage, $0.0015/GB reads, $0.004/GB writes at iad1.

Plan fee: Pro $20/month platform fee (1 deploying seat and $20/month usage credit, which expires monthly), extra seats $20/month each. Hobby $0. Pro and Enterprise list the same rates except data transfer, and Enterprise plans have custom pricing; Hobby usage is never billed. The list-price basis is Pro, with data transfer at the iad1 rate; 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 also run on Hobby (free within quota, then creation is paused); 8/16 needs Pro.

Plan allowance: Hobby, per month: 5 active CPU-hours, 420 GB-hours, 5,000 creations, 20 GB data transfer, 15 GB snapshot storage (lifetime); 10 concurrent sandboxes, 45-minute sessions, at most 4 vCPU / 8 GB; past the quota creation is paused, never billed. At 2 vCPU / 4 GiB that is 105 sandbox-hours of memory or 2.5 h of full CPU (25 h at 10% active). Pro: the $20/month credit applies to sandbox usage.

creations.how: One session record for each Vercel sandbox session.

intervals.how: Vercel session startedAt to stoppedAt from vercel.sessions.get.

active_cpu.how: Sum of activeCpuDurationMs from vercel.sessions.get records.

egress.how: Sum of networkTransfer.egress from vercel.sessions.get records.
